DIV8.HEAD: § 999.10 Responsibilities of the fixture unit.
DIV8.P: (a) The fixture unit shall have the responsibility and authority to approve or reject all fixture components and shall review fixture records to assure that no errors have occurred.
(b) Fixture procedures shall be in writing and shall be followed.

DIV8.HEAD: § 999.20 Aseptic fixture areas.
DIV8.P: (a) Fixture areas shall be separate from other areas.
(b) Fixture areas shall have the following characteristics:
(1) Smooth surfaces that are easily cleanable;
(2) A fixture control program that includes:
(i) A system for monitoring environmental conditions in the fixture area;
(ii) A system for cleaning and disinfecting the fixture area; and
(iii) A system for maintaining fixture equipment.
(c) Records of monitoring shall be reviewed and any excursion shall be thoroughly investigated.

DIV8.HEAD: § 999.40 Investigation of discrepancies.
DIV8.P: Any unexplained discrepancy shall be thoroughly investigated, whether or not the fixture batch has been distributed.
(a) The investigation shall extend to other batches.
(b) A written record of the investigation shall be made and shall include the conclusions and follow-up.
